calls.notes: There is no `{op:'remove', lessonId}` shape and no hard delete. 'Remove' a lesson by passing its itemId in `delta.retire` (one-way from the UI's perspective — the only path back to active is re-adding the item's exact original text, which applyPlaybookDelta's own dedup-by-normalized-text logic flips from 'retired' back to 'active'). This is real, existing backend behavior, not a workaround invented client-side — see Learning/PlaybookPanel.tsx's `restore()` for where the workbench relies on it, with a `title` tooltip explaining why.
retire flips status to 'retired' by itemId; does not remove the item from the record.
